description: This file is a shell script designed for testing Git patch formatting and subject preservation. It defines functions to create patches with different subjects and verify that their subjects are preserved after applying with 'git am'. The script performs setup, creates patches with various subject formats, and conducts tests to ensure subjects are handled correctly across different patching scenarios.

methods.name: make_patches
methods.description: Creates patches with specified subject types ('short', 'long', 'multiline') by committing changes and generating patches with 'git format-patch'.

methods.name: check_subject
methods.description: Verifies that a patch with a given subject has been correctly applied by applying the patch with 'git am' and comparing the commit message to the expected value.
